notes: Only the name-part AVENUE of Spring Grove Avenue and of Mitchell Avenue is printed inside the strip; MITCHELL is printed farther north-west on the plate (about x 3500, y 4300), Spring Grove taken from the plate description. Este Avenue: 'ESTE' and 'AVE.' printed along the street west of the strip. Carthage is printed without a suffix ('CARTHAGE'), Avenue assumed; it carries car tracks and is cut by the plate edge on its east side. Mitchell/Kessler: a short unnamed stub leaves Mitchell on the south side almost opposite Kessler (about 5805,6385), cut by the plate edge. Mitchell/? at 6465,6745: unnamed stub south of Mitchell, cut by the plate edge. Mitchell/Carthage: two more arms are cut by the plate edge, one to the south (only 'St.' visible) and one to the east-north-east (only 'C' visible). 'BANK' with '25' at about 6550,2040 is a 25 ft strip running east from the Mill Creek along a property line (N 86 W); recorded as an alley, it meets no street inside the strip. Middle of the strip is the Mill Creek, rail yards, the canal and the cemetery: no streets. Carthage/? at 7441,4958: stub street east of Carthage cut by the plate edge, only the letter 'O' of its name visible. Carthage/? at 7147,6150: unnamed stub east of Carthage, cut by the plate edge.
